_comment: Prices are the supplier's cost in USD per million tokens; FORGE_MARKUP is applied on top. Token Factory models are FREE to users (pricing "free", owner decision 2026-11-15): Token Factory charges Forge nothing during its beta, so a request needs a balance key and is never held or charged (docs/PAYMENTS.md, Free models). They carry no token price; the 1.0 in / 4.0 out per million placeholders they had before were never from a rate card and were dropped. When the beta ends, set pricing back to paid with prices from the Token Factory rate card (their /v1/model/info returned no cost fields on 2026-11-09). Context lengths below are from that endpoint's max_input_tokens. Tinfoil prices were read from https://inference.tinfoil.sh/v1/models on 2026-11-09. Cached input prices (cached_input_usd_per_mtok, the price of input tokens Tinfoil serves from its prompt cache) were read from cachedInputTokenPricePer1M at https://inference.tinfoil.sh/v1/models and https://api.tinfoil.sh/api/config/models on 2026-11-20: deepseek-v4-1-flash 0.01, glm-5-3 0.45, kimi-k3-1-pro 0.40; the other Tinfoil models in this catalog list none, so their cached input is charged at the input price. Audio models (the audio list) were read from https://api.tinfoil.sh/api/config/models on 2026-11-13: whisper-large-v3-turbo requestPrice 0.01 USD and voxtral-tts requestPrice 0.002 USD per request, no token price; voices from docs.tinfoil.sh/guides/processing-audio. Web search (2026-11-14): Tinfoil's Private Web Search requestPrice 0.05 USD per request that searched, from https://api.tinfoil.sh/api/config/models (model websearch, type tool); every Tinfoil chat model listed there has toolCalling true, and docs.tinfoil.sh/guides/web-search says search is used alongside chat models. extra_input_tokens and output_factor are Forge's hold allowance for what a search adds (results in the input, several model calls), not Tinfoil figures. Speed marks (2026-11-15): fast or slow from an API battery of the free Token Factory models (median seconds to the first words / to the whole answer): fast = GLM 5.3 Flash 1.2/1.6, Nemotron 3 Ultra 1.8/3.2, GLM 5.3 2.3/7.7, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 2.9/3.8, GLM 5.3 Flash Uncensored 2.7/4.9; slow = Qwen 3.8 27B 7.1/9.1, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Uncensored 10.2/12.6, Kimi K3 Abliterated 13.0/13.6, GLM 5.3 Uncensored 36.6/61.5, Kimi K3.1 Pro 59.3/74.3; Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 4.1/4.8 is left unmarked. The private (Tinfoil) models were measured the same way and are all fast: gemma4-31b 1.0/1.9, llama3-3-70b 1.1/4.8, deepseek-v4-1-flash 2.1/2.3, gpt-oss-120b 2.4/6.2, glm-5-3 2.8/3.4, kimi-k3-1-pro 2.9/3.5 (the private Kimi K3.1 Pro is fast while the free Standard one is slow). A model not measured carries no mark.
